title: Foundry Prompt Agent Manifest
description: Deployment-neutral description of an Azure AI Foundry prompt agent. The manifest is source of truth in Git and is converted to an Agent Service payload at deploy time by ConvertTo-FoundryAgentPayload.

name.description: Logical agent name. Stable across environments and used as the promotion key.

version.description: Semantic version of the agent definition. Bump on every functional change.

contact.description: Distribution list or Teams channel. Do not use personal contact details.

responsibleAiReviewId.description: Identifier of the completed Responsible AI review record.

deploymentName.description: Name of the model deployment in the target Foundry account. Environment overlays normally override this.

modelFamily.description: Informational only, for inventory and governance reporting.

jsonSchemaFile.description: Repository-relative path to the JSON schema used when type is json_schema.

file.description: Path, relative to the manifest, of the Markdown instruction file.

tools.description: Tool references. Each entry points at a tool definition file validated by tool-definition.schema.json.

ref.description: Path, relative to the manifest, of the tool definition file.

suiteFile.description: Path, relative to the manifest, of the evaluation suite.

required.description: When true, promotion gates fail if the evaluation suite is missing or below threshold.

metadata.description: Key/value pairs propagated to Agent Service metadata. Values must be strings (Agent Service constraint).
